name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Unity-Skills: AI Automation for Unity Development
short_description: Unity-Skills offers a suite of AI automation tools tailored for Unity developers, enhancing productivity and streamlining workflows. Ideal for game development, these skills simplify complex tasks and improve efficiency in project execution.
author: Besty0728

sections.overview:
Unity-Skills is a suite of AI agent skills designed specifically for Unity developers using Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI tools. The project provides automation capabilities that integrate with Unity's development environment to handle complex tasks and improve workflow efficiency. It includes skills for script operations, scene analysis, shader graph editing, and UI Toolkit integration. The toolkit supports asynchronous job processing and perception-based skills for scene understanding. Developers can leverage these skills to reduce manual effort on repetitive tasks and accelerate game development cycles.
Automating repetitive coding tasks in Unity
Generating game asset scripts
Enhancing debugging processes
Streamlining project management in Unity
sections.usage:
```
Generate a Unity-specific asset optimization report for [PROJECT_NAME] using Unity-Skills. Analyze the current asset usage, identify unused or redundant textures/models with [MEMORY_THRESHOLD]MB+ size, and suggest compression settings for [FORMAT] (e.g., ASTC, ETC2). For each asset, provide estimated memory savings in MB and performance impact metrics. Include a prioritized list of assets to optimize first based on [IMPACT_SCORE] (memory savings × performance gain).
```

requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: GitHub Copilot, VS Code
